translate_en|mods/BritaGunworksLegacyMag: Restores the magazine system from before September 28 while keeping other updates. New magazines are replaced with old ones, ammunition is preserved, and excess rounds are returned separately. Enable or disable through the mod manager and restart the game. Future features support and bug-free experiences are not guaranteed. Guns of Marz compatibility may be reduced.
